title: DECSET 1002 — Button-event mouse tracking
summary: CSI ? 1002 h enables button-event mouse tracking: the terminal reports button press, release, and motion while a button is held. CSI ? 1002 l disables it.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

params.name: Enable (DECSET)
params.meaning: CSI ? 1002 h Mouse tracking; button events + motion while pressed.

gotchas: Button-event tracking adds motion reports only while a button is held (less noisy than 1003).
Requires a mouse protocol encoding (1000 basic, 1006 SGR, or 1015 URXVT) to carry coordinates.
Always disable (1002 l) on exit to avoid flooding the shell with mouse escapes.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 1002 render as byte-exact CSI ? 1002 h/l sequences.
